description: Source code for the FileBlobCache class, which manages caching of binary blobs with file persistence, including CRC validation, file I/O, and memory mapping.

classes.name: FileBlobCache
classes.description: A class that implements a file-backed cache for binary blobs, supporting CRC validation, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: crc32c
methods.description: Computes CRC32C checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: FileBlobCache::FileBlobCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache from a file if it exists, validating its magic number and CRC.

methods.name: FileBlobCache::writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes cache contents and writes them to a file, including CRC and magic number.

methods.name: FileBlobCache::getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the cache including header if filename is set.
